9.t: Working with data: comparing ribosomal RNA
q: Identify the closest free-living relative of each organelle.
Explain how these data support the endosymbiotic theory.
The organelles’ rRNA is much more like that of free-living bacteria than like the nuclear rRNA of the same cell, so the organelles are probably descended from engulfed bacteria.
Nuclear rRNA is most similar to archaea. Suggest what this shows about the host cell.
The cell that engulfed the bacteria was probably an archaeon, or closely related to archaea.
Explain why the mitochondrial rRNA is not 100% similar to alphaproteobacteria.
Since the engulfing, well over a billion years ago, both lineages have mutated independently.
State two other kinds of evidence for endosymbiosis.
Any two: double membrane; their own circular DNA; 70S ribosomes; they divide by binary fission; sensitive to some antibiotics.
